channel.title: Manas — Field Notes
channel.description: Security research, engineering and systems notes by Manas.

item.title: Infrastructure Patterns and Recon: How Systems Betray Themselves
item.description: A technical method for turning DNS, certificate logs, code, and client-side clues into testable infrastructure hypotheses without confusing correlation with ownership.

item.title: Antenna Theory and Wave Propagation: Fundamentals for Security Researchers
item.description: A practical derivation of wavelength, antenna gain, path loss, noise, multipath, and what a radio link budget can actually tell a security researcher.

item.title: The Zero-Sum Silicon Game: Analyzing US Tech Dominance via the PPF Model
item.description: A production-possibilities model for semiconductor design, fabrication, packaging, and the bottlenecks that make simple zero-sum stories misleading.

item.title: Cron Jobs and Privilege Escalation: Mechanics and Mitigation
item.description: A close look at cron's privilege boundary: path resolution, file ownership, shell behavior, race conditions, safe auditing, and how to design jobs that do not inherit writable code.
